<h1>Meshery v0.5.20</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.20">Released</a> on June 09, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Tooltip UI for Load generators @DantrazTrev (#3129)</li>
<li>Handle API key change in Grafana Marics Settings @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3157)</li>
<li>[Docs] update instructions for upgrading meshery docker deployment @DelusionalOptimist (#3155)</li>
<li>Fixed handleOperatorClick chip @dhruv0000 (#3146)</li>
<li>fixes for operator flow @kumarabd (#3147)</li>
<li>fix[UI]: Make Meshery logo stick to the top in Navigator @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3133)</li>
<li>Fix the user Profile shifting issue in Meshery UI @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3144)</li>
<li>Allow users to set channel as stable-vX.X.X @metonymic-smokey (#3148)</li>
<li>Fixed channel set panic @metonymic-smokey (#3145)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump billboard.js from 2.2.3 to 3.0.3 in /ui @dependabot (#3103)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Meshery Adapters page @leecalcote (#3152)</li>
<li>[Docs] - Update command reference pages @Blakelist7 (#3002)</li>
</ul>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.24</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.24">Released</a> on June 18, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix Meshery logo click behaviour @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3225)</li>
<li>fix edge channel deployments @navendu-pottekkat (#3233)</li>
<li>[Bug fix] Fixed <code>dataFetch</code> catching error when getting Grafana Boards @dhruv0000 (#3220)</li>
<li>change service port @s1ntaxe770r (#3224)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Wait for pods to terminate on <code>system stop</code> @navendu-pottekkat (#3227)</li>
<li>meshery fixes for kubeconfig @kumarabd (#3228)</li>
<li>switch provider package to edge-latest @kumarabd (#3221)</li>
<li>Kumarabd/feature/broker @kumarabd (#3219)</li>
<li>changes for kubeconfig validation @kumarabd (#3191)</li>
<li>Moved swagger.yaml to /helpers @piyushsingariya (#3211)</li>
<li>[ui] Update grammar in operator removal message @josephmidura (#3188)</li>
<li>Fix #3192: Fix installation steps in mesheryctl bash file @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3193)</li>
<li>Update README.md: Fix meshery badges @amino19 (#3194)</li>
<li>Add dynamic Management Pane UI @utkarsh-pro (#3202)</li>
<li>Added imports for remote provider extensions @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3203)</li>
<li>Added Application UI @Chadha93 (#3186)</li>
<li>Reverted <code>gqlpraser</code>, Addon Resolvers Fix and added Make commands @dhruv0000 (#3181)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] <code>mesheryctl perf</code> subcommands @piyushsingariya (#3082)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added <code>mesheryctl exp application</code> @piyushsingariya (#3170)</li>
<li>Fix Netlify builds @ramrodo (#3179)</li>
<li>operator panic fix @kumarabd (#3172)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] - Fixed CI Failing Issue Due to Error in Syntax of Main FIle @adithyaakrishna (#3190)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Update CodeCov report configuration @ramrodo (#3177)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>docs and make updated for error utils @kumarabd (#3216)</li>
<li>[Docs] <code>mesheryctl system mesh validate</code> page added @amino19 (#3149)</li>
<li>Added the new releases of meshery to Docs @iambami (#3196)</li>
<li>[Docs] - Fixed CI Failing Issue Due to Error in Syntax of Main FIle @adithyaakrishna (#3190)</li>
<li>[Docs] - Added status command files @umairnsr87 (#3086)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @Ayush-Khandelwal-007, @Chadha93, @adithyaakrishna, @amino19, @dhruv0000, @iambami, @josephmidura, @kumarabd, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @ramrodo, @s1ntaxe770r, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @umairnsr87 and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.26</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.26">Released</a> on June 24, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI]Update remote-component.config.js @killbotXD (#3249)</li>
<li>Partial Bugfix for #3245 ( Kubernetes part ) @anirudhjain75 (#3252)</li>
<li>MeshKit errors for Handlers + bug fixes @dhruv0000 (#3263)</li>
<li>margins for menu items adjusted @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3261)</li>
<li>CRUD for applications @navendu-pottekkat (#3213)</li>
<li>Fix for Grafana breaking changes in v7.4 + minor bug fixes  @dhruv0000 (#3247)</li>
<li>[Meshery] Handle the temp directory creation/deletion for mac OS @hexxdump (#3242)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Unit Testing Setup @piyushsingariya (#3137)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Updated Jekyll tutorial to Meshery Documentation @debjani1413 (#3116)</li>
<li>updated performance docs @NagaHarshita (#3218)</li>
<li>[Docs] Fix and cleanup issues in Meshery docs @alphaX86 (#3229)</li>
<li>[Roadmap] Adding milestone hyperlinks @leecalcote (#3265)</li>
<li>[Docs] Updated contributing docs for better instructions to compile and run meshery server from source @pranav-bhatt (#3236)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Ayush-Khandelwal-007, @NagaHarshita, @alphaX86, @anirudhjain75, @debjani1413, @dhruv0000, @hexxdump, @killbotXD, @kumarabd, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya and @pranav-bhatt</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.27</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.27">Released</a> on June 30, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>test meshery build code @nehaLohia27 (#3301)</li>
<li>netlify build code for meshery repo @nehaLohia27 (#3300)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Minor fix for  <code>mesheryctl system status</code> @piyushsingariya (#3298)</li>
<li>REST API and GraphQL docs @kaushambisharma (#3294)</li>
<li>contributing meshery errors updated @kumarabd (#3289)</li>
<li>update workflows to reflect meshery repo change @navendu-pottekkat (#3290)</li>
<li>Refactor some part of helpers and split into related packages
@anirudhjain75 (#3259)</li>
<li>Open API Docs #3 @piyushsingariya (#3173)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] <code>perf apply</code> Performance-id replaced with performance-name @piyushsingariya (#3254)</li>
<li>Add support for JSONSchema Draft4 in RJSF @utkarsh-pro (#3278)</li>
<li>Adds a New Line for the finalMSG @DantrazTrev (#3264)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump normalize-url from 4.5.0 to 4.5.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot   (#3292)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Open API Docs #2 @piyushsingariya (#3075)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DantrazTrev, @Nikhil-Ladha, @anirudhjain75, @dependabot, @dependabo[bot], @dhruv0000, @kaushambisharma, @kumarabd, @leecalcote,@navendu-pottekkat, @nehaLohia27, @piyushsingariya and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.3</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.3">Released</a> on April 28, 2021</h4>

<h3 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h3>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] - Added Releases from v0.4.23 to v0.5.1 @adithyaakrishna (#2756)</li>
<li>Meshery Operator - Lifecycle Management @metonymic-smokey (#2736)</li>
<li>Add &ldquo;order by&rdquo; query sanitization @utkarsh-pro (#2745)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] <code>mesheryctl exp preflight</code> to verify environment readiness for a Meshery deloyment @piyushsingariya (#2743)</li>
<li>[Docs] - Fixes Date Issue in v0.4.2 @adithyaakrishna (#2755)</li>
<li>[Docs] - Added Release Notes for v0.5.2 and Changed Casing @adithyaakrishna (#2753)</li>
<li>Bug Fixes @dhruv0000 (#2742)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] update the roadmap of mesheryctl @hexxdump (#2746)</li>
<li>Added Examples for Request Header Fields @adithyaakrishna (#2739)</li>
<li>docs(roadmap): add an entry for meshery v0.5.0 @bnbjin (#2735)</li>
<li>add icons to remote component config  @Tanuj22 (#2732)</li>
<li>[UI] Add commas to one thousandth place @Kn99HN (#2725)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added <code>pattern view</code> @aneeshnema (#2671)</li>
<li>Prerequisite added for testing Go code. #Issue 2588 @sakshi3537 (#2721)</li>
<li>Fixed Flip Card Animation in Big Sur @utkarsh-pro (#2720)</li>
<li>Correct links in Doc pages @alphaX86 (#2719)</li>
<li>Deleting resources on system stop @metonymic-smokey (#2695)</li>
<li>Add API for importing pattern files from github @utkarsh-pro (#2705)</li>
<li>Include UserID in the patterns reponse JSON @utkarsh-pro (#2718)</li>
<li>fixes for cases listed below @kumarabd (#2715)</li>
<li>[Mesheryctl] Added list to context @Kn99HN (#2713)</li>
<li>[Mesheryctl] Update comments for system command @Kn99HN (#2714)</li>
<li>Few updates to the UI contributing guide @Nikhil-Ladha (#2703)</li>
<li>Fix the CI of lint chart @Aisuko (#2707)</li>
<li>Add customize way to choice deploy the meshery adapters @Aisuko (#2664)</li>
<li>[Mesheryctl][Kubernetes] Replace <code>latest</code> with exact version after fetching manifest files @piyushsingariya (#2662)</li>
<li>Added a section for WebAssembly filter in the README @Abiola-Farounbi (#2706)</li>
<li>Added GraphQL Docs @dhruv0000 (#2704)</li>
<li>[WIP][Meshery] Fix Kube API authentication issue with GKE @hexxdump (#2674)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] Helm Chart Releaser Workflow: update helm chart location @leecalcote (#2757)</li>
<li>[Security] Static analysis using CodeQL @leecalcote (#2650)</li>
<li>Add the CI for auto release the Helm chart @Aisuko (#2675)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/prometheus/common from 0.18.0 to 0.20.0 @dependabot (#2685)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/golang/protobuf from 1.4.3 to 1.5.2 @dependabot (#2688)</li>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.36.0 to 1.37.0 @dependabot (#2687)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/lib/pq from 1.7.0 to 1.10.0 @dependabot (#2690)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/olekukonko/tablewriter from 0.0.2 to 0.0.5 @dependabot (#2691)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/qri-io/jsonschema from 0.2.0 to 0.2.1 @dependabot (#2694)</li>
<li>Separate into two workflows the release drafter and the release notes jobs @ramrodo (#2697)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshery-operator from 0.2.11 to 0.2.12 @dependabot (#2689)</li>
<li>Bump fortio.org/fortio from 1.14.1 to 1.14.2 @dependabot (#2686)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/prometheus/client_golang from 1.9.0 to 1.10.0 @dependabot (#2693)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/Mesheryio/nighthawk-go from 0.1.5 to 0.1.6 @dependabot (#2692)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>add v0.5.0 to mesheryctl roadmap @Micost (#2734)</li>
<li>Update Broken Link at Meshery Docs NGINX-SM Page @adithyaakrishna (#2727)</li>
<li>Create Individual doc pages (WIP) @alphaX86 (#2665)</li>
<li>README: Update the SMP screenshot @Anita-ihuman (#2710)</li>
<li>A brief proposal for the manage of Error code Reference @alonsolopezr (#2702)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.30</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.30">Released</a> on July 02, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">

</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>meshkit errors added @kumarabd (#3370)</li>
<li>Open API Docs #4 @piyushsingariya (#3342)</li>
<li>Remove the configuration of helm-releaser that we no longer need @Aisuko (#3364)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.32</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.32">Released</a> on July 09, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix RJSF stale state issue @utkarsh-pro (#3418)</li>
<li>Add login and logout command to mesheryctl @utkarsh-pro (#3396)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/meshery/meshsync from 0.1.21 to 0.1.23 @dhruv0000 (#3416)</li>
<li>Changed the port , added prefix and the namespace into the istio yml @samirparhi-dev (#3232)</li>
<li>broker connection issue fixed for plugins @kumarabd (#3403)</li>
<li>[UI] New Notification Design implementation @jeantiston (#3197)</li>
<li>Gracefully handling invalid meshconfig errors @metonymic-smokey (#3198)</li>
<li>E2E demo plugins @killbotXD (#3404)</li>
<li>[Chore] Update in  roadmap @piyushsingariya (#3392)</li>
<li>Actions Enhancement for Meshery Patterns @Chadha93 (#3345)</li>
<li>Updated the meshkit error for schedule_handler.go  @Shreyas220 (#3384)</li>
<li>Updated the meshkit error for load_test_meshes_handler.go  @debjani1413 (#3381)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Release Notes for Meshery v0.5.32 @l5io (#3388)</li>
<li>[Unit Testing] Unit Testing for  @piyushsingariya (#3288)</li>
<li>“move codecov from root to .github” @suhaniii (#3377)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[README] add: Community Forum @amino19 (#3272)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Aisuko, @Chadha93, @Nikhil-Ladha, @Shreyas220, @amino19, @debjani1413, @dhruv0000, @hexxdump, @jeantiston, @killbotXD, @kumarabd, @l5io, @leecalcote, @metonymic-smokey, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @samirparhi-dev, @suhaniii, @utkarsh-pro and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.33</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.33">Released</a> on July 10, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added filter-mangement.md @sayantan1413 (#3237)</li>
<li>Add maintainers and update code owners @navendu-pottekkat (#3398)</li>
<li>Fix for provider_ui not showing images and favicon @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3424)</li>
<li>[Provider UI] Fix broken logo image @leecalcote (#3425)</li>
<li>Activity indicator: system start on kubernetes @NagaHarshita (#3256)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl]  @piyushsingariya (#3253)</li>
<li>Feature/ayush khandelwal 007/metrics overhaul @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3419)</li>
<li>Bump next js to 11.0.1 in provider ui @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3417)</li>
<li>Added  in  @dhruv0000 (#3420)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI][WIP] integrating error codes utility into CI @DelusionalOptimist (#3296)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI][WIP] integrating error codes utility into CI @DelusionalOptimist (#3296)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Ayush-Khandelwal-007, @DelusionalOptimist, @NagaHarshita, @Nikhil-Ladha, @dhruv0000, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @piyushsingariya, @sayantan1413 and @sudo-NithishKarthik</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.37</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.37">Released</a> on July 14, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fix  @DelusionalOptimist (#3449)</li>
<li>[UI] Naming fix for Patterns, Applications, Filters @Chadha93 (#3448)</li>
<li>Bump addressable from 2.7.0 to 2.8.0 in /docs @dependabot (#3494)</li>
<li>Add  endpoint to serve the filter file @navendu-pottekkat (#3467)</li>
<li>[UI] Application actions and endpoints envoked @Chadha93 (#3464)</li>
<li>Nithish/pattern UI imp @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3455)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Updated docker/k8s conflict in  @piyushsingariya (#3491)</li>
<li>[CI] Open API Specification and Documentation workflow @amino19 (#3239)</li>
<li>Bump billboard.js from 3.0.3 to 3.1.2 @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3465)</li>
<li>Changed Notification Message Wrapping and Bell Button On Click @jeantiston (#3460)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fixing docker/k8s conflict incase of platform docker @piyushsingariya (#3490)</li>
<li>updates meshkit error for load test handler @warunicorn19 (#3371)</li>
<li>Profile cards changes @Ayush-Khandelwal-007 (#3454)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] system  and  Integration Testing @piyushsingariya (#3430)</li>
<li>skip workflow run on forks @iamsdas (#3432)</li>
<li>Updated the meshkit error for performance_profiles_handler and provider_handler @Shreyas220 (#3397)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fix for  Not Set in stable releases @piyushsingariya (#3461)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] - Refactored Old Docs with Emoji @adithyaakrishna (#3457)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.38</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.38">Released</a> on July 14, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>update go-version in CI doc @navendu-pottekkat (#3582)</li>
<li>Updated UI to show SMI version @dhruv0000 (#3580)</li>
<li>graphql refactor @kumarabd (#3567)</li>
<li>[Meshery] Reworking <code>/experiment/pattern</code> endpoints @piyushsingariya (#3542)</li>
<li>@vijcheru Called Meshkit Error Handler instead of Logrus @vijcheru (#3387)</li>
<li>[Mesheryctl] server_spec_handler (meshkit) @Chadha93 (#3561)</li>
<li>[Mesheryctl] session_sync_handler (meshkit) @Chadha93 (#3560)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fix: Added description for the <code>system logs</code> command @muskankhedia (#3284)</li>
<li>Sets default value for namespace in management page @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3564)</li>
<li>Add settings page path to exportPathMap @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3548)</li>
<li>Fix indentation problem in label commentor workflow file @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3552)</li>
<li>Issue #3401/Added field token-location in meshery system context view @Revolyssup (#3408)</li>
<li>refactor mesheryctl 1 - Add getters and setters to config and refactor start.go @navendu-pottekkat (#3546)</li>
<li>use latest version of error codes utility in the err-codes-updater workflow @DelusionalOptimist (#3539)</li>
<li>[UI] Pass remote provider page titles verbatim @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3532)</li>
<li>Migrated errors for models package #2 @dhruv0000 (#3528)</li>
<li>fix for prometheus connectivity bug @kumarabd (#3537)</li>
<li>updated Validator.go @Shreyas220 (#3533)</li>
<li>mesheryctl features @kumarabd (#3514)</li>
<li>fix broken dependency @killbotXD (#3526)</li>
<li>creating issue/remind label text @Anita-ihuman (#3523)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] <code>mesheryctl pattern apply -f &lt;github-url&gt;</code> @piyushsingariya (#3489)</li>
<li>Add icon dependencies for remote provider  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3519)</li>
<li>[UI]add duplicate button @killbotXD (#3524)</li>
<li>[Fix]Re-enable support for patterns, filters and applications in local provider @utkarsh-pro (#3515)</li>
<li>Updated bitcask smiresultss persister @Shreyas220 (#3509)</li>
<li>Upgraded the meshkit error for helpers directory @sayantan1413 (#3506)</li>
<li>Migrated errors for <code>models</code> package @dhruv0000 (#3505)</li>

</ul>

<li>perf: Delete the <code>apt-get</code> lists after installing something @iamrajiv (#3535)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.39</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.39">Released</a> on July 25, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Revert dynamic provider version @utkarsh-pro (#3647)</li>
<li>remove codeowners @navendu-pottekkat (#3646)</li>
<li>Issue #3508/ added token command for CRUD operations @Revolyssup (#3522)</li>
<li>[UI] Filters: Action Enhancements @Chadha93 (#3638)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.40</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.40">Released</a> on July 27, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>patch NavigatetoBrowser for missing xdg-open @navendu-pottekkat (#3665)</li>
<li>added swagger api video link to docs @warunicorn19 (#3663)</li>
<li>added check for docker or kubernetes platform @nehaLohia27 (#3562)</li>
<li>Migrated GraphQL resolver logic to models @dhruv0000 (#3652)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added PreRunE Health Checks for multiple system commands @piyushsingariya (#3649)</li>
<li>Open API Docs /system endpoint @piyushsingariya (#3641)</li>
<li>[UI] Bulk selection and delete operation in Filters UI  @Chadha93 (#3650)</li>
<li>Update Maintainer.md @sayantan1413 (#3648)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Open API: Provider endpoint @piyushsingariya (#3578)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
