<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.41</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.41">Released</a> on July 28, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Upgraded to meshkit error @sayantan1413 (#3610)</li>
<li>Revert &ldquo;[UI] block fetch to grafana or prometheus if not configured&rdquo; @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3677)</li>
<li>system start fails with empty platform flag @nehaLohia27 (#3675)</li>
<li>added meshery operator logo to docs @debo19 (#3676)</li>
<li>changed the message to view the status of pods @guptapriyanshu7 (#3672)</li>
<li>[UI] block fetch to grafana or prometheus if not configured @bariqhibat (#3595)</li>
<li>[Docs] Custom Callback @utkarsh-pro (#3655)</li>
<li>[CI] Fixed the lint failure @sayantan1413 (#3669)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Unit tests for <code>system context</code> @Revolyssup (#3555)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Revolyssup, @bariqhibat, @debo19, @dhruv0000, @guptapriyanshu7, @hexxdump, @leecalcote, @nehaLohia27, @piyushsingariya, @sayantan1413, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @utkarsh-pro and l5io</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.42</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.42">Released</a> on August 04, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>MeshSync DB fix @dhruv0000 (#3775)</li>
<li>Delete extra golden file in testdata @alphaX86 (#3772)</li>
<li>Added SSE client for CLI to wait for operation to end @dhruv0000 (#3689)</li>
<li>Changed the test file name @Revolyssup (#3767)</li>
<li>[Docs] REST API: <code>/system</code> endpoint @piyushsingariya (#3518)</li>
<li>[Fixes] Version Card Fix @dhruv0000 (#3763)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fix for <code>perf view</code> @piyushsingariya (#3762)</li>
<li>Added <code>User Data</code> and <code>User Pref</code> in HTTP request context @dhruv0000 (#3753)</li>
<li>fix whitespace in GraphQL API workflow @DelusionalOptimist (#3752)</li>
<li>[UI] Change the dev server script to use node rather than nodemon @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3750)</li>
<li>[GraphQL] Added Token to Req context @dhruv0000 (#3748)</li>
<li>[meshery] fix bug docker couldnt find swagger.yaml @bariqhibat (#3644)</li>
<li>Handled closing for <code>listenToControlPlaneState</code> Subscription @dhruv0000 (#3741)</li>
<li>Fix SSE for perf-test @dhruv0000 (#3742)</li>
<li>Migrating system stop to meshkit style errors @metonymic-smokey (#3693)</li>
<li>Fix duplicate env vars issue @utkarsh-pro (#3717)</li>
<li>[DOCS] add fix bug for key/value size invalid  @bariqhibat (#3713)</li>
<li>[UI] UI enhancements (Bulk operations) @Chadha93 (#3718)</li>
<li>[Extension] dependency-addition @Chadha93 (#3716)</li>
<li>Add subcommand app @suhaniii (#3540)</li>
<li>Fix for Perf Test getting invoked @dhruv0000 (#3710)</li>
<li>changed the messages for controlplane and meshsync @warunicorn19 (#3711)</li>
<li>Fix UI handler behaviour @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3705)</li>
<li>[meshery]meshery bash script to allow installation of cli alone @hexxdump (#3692)</li>
<li>ui: Align adapter cards and make it vertically even @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3695)</li>
<li>ui: Change Navigator Design according to latest requirements @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3581)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Gracefully handle errors when platform is unavailable @alphaX86 (#3585)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fixes in <code>system check</code> @piyushsingariya (#3666)</li>
<li>update to pkg/browser to open URLs @navendu-pottekkat (#3682)</li>
<li>Connection Wizard @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3501)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Add GET request step in HealthCheck @alphaX86 (#3495)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl]Check for Meshery server status before opening in browser @hexxdump (#3685)</li>
<li>Fix application workload JSON schema @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3686)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Backup meshconfig: Version fixes @metonymic-smokey (#3463)</li>
<li>meshery: Fix read operation not waiting for user input @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3681)</li>
</ul>

</h2>
<ul>

<li>chore(deps-dev): bump start-server-and-test from 1.13.0 to 1.13.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3725)</li>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.43</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.43">Released</a> on August 07, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fixed the chevron problem @warunicorn19 (#3794)</li>
<li>[DashboardComponent] Changes settings button styling in notification bar  @CipherGirl (#3801)</li>
<li>made changes to the performance calender @warunicorn19 (#3808)</li>
<li>Fix Data Fetch and Logic from the server causing problems with pattern deployment @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3809)</li>
<li>Remove cypress test spec for dashboard button  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3803)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection wizard] Fix the meshery operator step connection status @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3806)</li>
<li>Updated the Maintainers.md file @debjani1413 (#3802)</li>
<li>Added custom context support in installer @devansh42 (#3498)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Unit Tests for <code>system token</code> @Revolyssup (#3737)</li>
<li>[UI] Meshery Navigator Menu Re-iteration @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3779)</li>
<li>[GraphQL] Query Performance fetch all results based on Performance Profile ID @bariqhibat (#3783)</li>
<li>Changed docker compose default location @metonymic-smokey (#3788)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Delete older application command @piyushsingariya (#3786)</li>
<li>[meshery] changes to installer script for missing utilities @hexxdump (#3789)</li>
<li>Refactor connection wizard @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3790)</li>
<li>Open API docs for application endpoint @sayantan1413 (#3643)</li>
<li>Added a save icon in the save button @sayantan1413 (#3687)</li>
<li>Added MeshSync Chip, Snackbar and Toolbar @Meghana-12 (#3698)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.44</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.44">Released</a> on August 09, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Revert &ldquo;Changed docker compose default location&rdquo; @navendu-pottekkat (#3824)</li>
<li>[UI] Implement proxying for websocket requests in development server @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3822)</li>
<li>[UI]] [Graphql] Use a single web socket connection for all graphql subscriptions @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3819)</li>
<li>Added the unit test for mesheryctl system reset command @sayantan1413 (#3738)</li>
<li>[GraphQL] Performance API - Integration frontend react relay @bariqhibat (#3785)</li>
<li>Open Test Result Modal by Clicking Calendar Event @CipherGirl (#3815)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fix for <code>mesheryctl start</code> platform preflight checks @piyushsingariya (#3707)</li>
<li>fix syntax error @suhaniii (#3810)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add lint pre-commit check with husky @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3704)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.45</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.45">Released</a> on August 10, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI]Fixed Notification Card Collapse behavior @NikhilSharma03 (#3835)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Added <code>-c</code> flag into <code>system view</code> command @afzal442 (#3813)</li>
<li>Refactor Patterns and add some features @utkarsh-pro (#3805)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[WIP] Updating operator docs @metonymic-smokey (#3817)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.46</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.46">Released</a> on August 13, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] added test for view and list @Revolyssup (#3861)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Avoid returning error if browser fails to open after starting meshery @Revolyssup (#3871)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Unit Tests for <code>mesheryctl app</code> @suhaniii (#3814)</li>
<li>Quick refactor @metonymic-smokey (#3851)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] exit codes in mesh validate sub commands @DelusionalOptimist (#3864)</li>
<li>[CI] Updated the github workflow for swagger docs @sayantan1413 (#3867)</li>
<li>Added the unit test for mesheryctl system restart command @Shreyas220 (#3858)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fix bugs in <code>mesheryctl mesh</code> sub commands @DelusionalOptimist (#3850)</li>
<li>added documentation for the eslint plugin @warunicorn19 (#3859)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Enhanced error for <code>mesherycytl exp filter list</code> @Revolyssup (#3849)</li>
<li>[meshery] Shifting <code>/application/</code> endpoints from &ldquo;experimental&rdquo; @piyushsingariya (#3852)</li>
<li>[Docs] Updated description of Hipster store sample app @afzal442 (#3842)</li>
<li>[UI] block fetch to grafana or prometheus if not configured @bariqhibat (#3847)</li>
<li>added swagger docs and fixed the error @warunicorn19 (#3839)</li>
<li>Fix a typo in connection wizard step two @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3832)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-features">
	🚀 Features
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl] Fixing <code>mesheryctl filter</code> command @piyushsingariya (#3843)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bump next from 11.0.1 to 11.1.0 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#3866)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>add meshery docs release for v0.5.40 @nehaLohia27 (#3846)</li>
<li>Fix broken links in Docs #3764 @sgibson19 (#3818)</li>
<li>[Docs] Release notes for v0.5.38 added @ghulamyazdani-bot (#3804)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DelusionalOptimist, @Revolyssup, @Shreyas220, @adithyaakrishna, @afzal442, @bariqhibat, @dependabot, @dependabot[bot], @ghulamyazdani-bot, @leecalcote, @metonymic-smokey, @navendu-pottekkat, @nehaLohia27, @piyushsingariya, @sayantan1413, @sgibson19, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @suhaniii and @warunicorn19</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.47</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.47">Released</a> on August 16, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Add more eslint rules to enforce strict formatting  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3845)</li>
<li>RJSF Styling changes for Meshery extenstions @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3879)</li>
<li>[UI] Updates RJSF Styling for Extension Point @Jashpatel1 (#3784)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.48</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.48">Released</a> on August 18, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Filters delete files(single select) @Chadha93 (#3887)</li>
<li>[UI] Snackbar Closing and Settings Btn Fixed @NikhilSharma03 (#3923)</li>
<li>[UI] Fix  &lsquo;Error communicating with Prometheus&rsquo; error  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3928)</li>
<li>Fix to unlock the db lock properly @dhruv0000 (#3927)</li>
<li>pattern apply &amp; delete unit test @suhaniii (#3921)</li>
<li>[UI] fix formatting of string @bariqhibat (#3922)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] started writing tests for utils @Revolyssup (#3883)</li>
<li>Added the OpenApi docs for filter endpoint @sayantan1413 (#3899)</li>
<li>[UI] [Pattern + Application] Delete operation (single select)  @Chadha93 (#3911)</li>
<li>[UI] Fetch metrics only when metrics components are configured @sudo-NithishKarthik (#3913)</li>
<li>[UI] Meshery Operator and MeshSync Chips overlapped fixed @NikhilSharma03 (#3882)</li>
<li>Move the Performance tab in settings page to user preferences page @yagarwal1307 (#3903)</li>
<li>Fix navigator sidebar to show help icon and chevron in mobile view @yagarwal1307 (#3904)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fixed the swagger workflow error @sayantan1413 (#3926)</li>
<li>Added the unit test for mesheryctl system update command @Shreyas220 (#3909)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix typo in the spanish documentation @jesus-lerma (#3906)</li>
<li>[Documentation] Fixed broken GitHub link @Rubix982 (#3907)</li>
</ul>

</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.50</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.50">Released</a> on August 28, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI]Reduce font padding and margin in RJSF tooltip @killbotXD (#4004)</li>
<li>Update RJSF styling for tooltip. @Jashpatel1 (#3953)</li>
<li>[UI] [Performance] Bulk delete bug fix  @Chadha93 (#3993)</li>
<li>fix error on onchange method @killbotXD (#4003)</li>
<li>fix broken default config @navendu-pottekkat (#3999)</li>
<li>Fix pattern capabilities registration - change port in docker-compose  @utkarsh-pro (#3983)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] go-routine fixed for invalid platform flag @piyushsingariya (#3998)</li>
<li>Changing version in manifests and meshconfig @metonymic-smokey (#3959)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] fixed default token location displayed twice @afzal442 (#3976)</li>
<li>[UI] Adapter: Display NGINX Service Mesh @leecalcote (#3989)</li>
<li>Added hover to Configuration and Conformance @warunicorn19 (#3964)</li>
<li>[UI] add mapper to podname and version @bariqhibat (#3956)</li>
<li>[UI] Bulk Delete in Filters + Patterns + Applications @Chadha93 (#3965)</li>
<li>Metrics window @warunicorn19 (#3963)</li>
<li>[UI] Import using URL added in filters @Meghana-12 (#3888)</li>
<li>Fix page layout in case of hovering over carousel @yagarwal1307 (#3942)</li>
<li>[UI] Dashboard: Added Hyperlink to Release Notes @CipherGirl (#3838)</li>
<li>[WIP] Cached manifests for skip update flag in Kubernetes @metonymic-smokey (#3880)</li>
<li>Patterns:  Add OAM patterns with RJSF form on every pattern column @Abhishek-kumar09 (#3925)</li>
<li>Fix user pref tabs UI @yagarwal1307 (#3943)</li>
<li>[mesheryctl] Reworking of <code>filter apply</code> command. @piyushsingariya (#3857)</li>
<li>Support minikube out of the box and multi k8s context support @utkarsh-pro (#3869)</li>
<li>Reworking of component endpoints + Open API docs @piyushsingariya (#3872)</li>
<li>Shifting <code>/filter/</code> endpoints out of experiment @piyushsingariya (#3924)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-features">
	🚀 Features
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Dataplane] add dataplane to dashboard @bariqhibat (#3854)</li>
<li>[Docs] Added Mesheryctl mesh deploy command  @afzal442 (#3889)</li>
<li>Updated helper.go to include meshery-nginx-sm @DanielLivingston32 (#3997)</li>
<li>[UI] Added URL Uploader in Applications and Patterns @Meghana-12 (#3991)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Handled requests made to <code>/provider</code> on Dev Server @sudhay23 (#4002)</li>
<li>Fixed <code>subscriptions-transport-ws</code> error in cypress tests @dhruv0000 (#4000)</li>
<li>Bump @babel/traverse from 7.14.7 to 7.15.0 in /ui @dependabot (#3811)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Added Mesheryctl mesh deploy command  @afzal442 (#3889)</li>
<li>[Docs] - Added New FAQ @The-Loony-Coder (#3837)</li>
<li>Docs - Static and Dynamic Boards concept @suhaniii (#3950)</li>
<li>removed installing mesheryctl from FAQ subheading @warunicorn19 (#3948)</li>
<li>fixed the kuma-error-codes generation in docs @warunicorn19 (#3949)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.51</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.51">Released</a> on August 29, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI]fixed the overflowing RJSF form @warunicorn19 (#4030)</li>
<li>[UI] Ability to maximize the Application and Pattern Editor @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4027)</li>
<li>Limited Calls to ValidateVersion @Revolyssup (#4031)</li>
<li>[UI] add default podname mapper @bariqhibat (#4029)</li>
<li>[UI] Fixed Overlay cards in Meshery Performance @mani9896 (#3979)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] dashboard bug - check types for meshScan @bariqhibat (#4026)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] prevent upload to codecov on forks @iamsdas (#4008)</li>
</ul>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.52</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.52">Released</a> on August 30, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] Change Pre-commit lint command to allow users to push formatted changes @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4014)</li>
<li>[chore] Minor chore @piyushsingariya (#4036)</li>
<li>[CI] Upgraded Code Coverage line-by-line @shikharvashistha (#4033)</li>
<li>fixing recent mesheryctl system start panic  @Revolyssup (#4035)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection Wizard] Add &lsquo;Configuration Done&rsquo; step  @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4016)</li>
<li>Capitalize Lables and remove margins from RJSF tooltip @killbotXD (#4007)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection Wizard] Fix Metrics icon overlap in Stepper @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4017)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection Wizard] Render adapter icons dynamically @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4018)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection Wizard] Add loading spinner for operator and kubernetes step @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4019)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection Wizard] Use black and white image for meshery logo in adapters page @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4011)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-bug-fixes">
	🐛 Bug Fixes
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[UI] fix continuous subscription initialization @bariqhibat (#4032)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.53</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.53">Released</a> on September 07, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix: Handle undefined title case @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4100)</li>
<li>[Extension] remove description on tooltip @bariqhibat (#4098)</li>
<li>fix(ui): use createTheme import instead of createMuiTheme - #4087 @K-Kumar-01 (#4095)</li>
<li>[chore] Update in roadmap for mesheryctl code-coverage @piyushsingariya (#4092)</li>
<li>added a tooltip to patterns icon @warunicorn19 (#4094)</li>
<li>Enhancement for MeshSync Settings Page @dhruv0000 (#3875)</li>
<li>feat(ui): eslint-ui - #4078 @K-Kumar-01 (#4086)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection Wizard] Scrolling issues in Adapter @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4015)</li>
<li>Added tests for <code>mesheryctl/internal/cli/root/config</code>  @shikharvashistha (#4047)</li>
<li>[UI] Improved UI in Performance Profile test results  @Meghana-12 (#4040)</li>
<li>[UI] add help tooltip to icon @bariqhibat (#4045)</li>
<li>[UI] The SMP vertical divider is now aligned properly @Hardikag17 (#4046)</li>
<li>system context @suhaniii (#4023)</li>
<li>[<Navigator/>]: Navigation highlight fix on subsections under Management section @nishit-prasad (#3271)</li>
<li>update in meshery-chart title format @veerreshr (#4006)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] bundle seed content into Docker image @DelusionalOptimist (#4082)</li>
<li>Bump caniuse-lite from 1.0.30001248 to 1.0.30001252 in /ui @dependabot (#4052)</li>
<li>Bump @rjsf/core from 3.0.0 to 3.1.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4062)</li>
<li>Bump mui-datatables from 3.7.7 to 3.7.8 in /ui @dependabot (#4057)</li>
<li>correct typo in roadmap.md @shreyaansjain (#4081)</li>
<li>Bump next from 11.1.0 to 11.1.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4073)</li>
<li>Bump cypress from 8.1.0 to 8.3.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4053)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-config-next from 11.0.1 to 11.1.2 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4054)</li>
<li>Bump react-big-calendar from 0.33.2 to 0.35.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4058)</li>
<li>Bump github.com/go-openapi/strfmt from 0.20.1 to 0.20.2 @dependabot (#4072)</li>
<li>Bump gorm.io/gorm from 1.21.12 to 1.21.14 @dependabot (#4069)</li>
<li>Bump husky from 7.0.1 to 7.0.2 in /ui @dependabot (#4066)</li>
<li>Bump eslint-plugin-react from 7.24.0 to 7.25.1 in /provider-ui @dependabot (#4061)</li>
<li>Bump google.golang.org/grpc from 1.39.0 to 1.40.0 @dependabot (#4067)</li>
<li>Bump @fortawesome/fontawesome-svg-core from 1.2.35 to 1.2.36 in /ui @dependabot (#4065)</li>
<li>Bump relay-compiler from 11.0.2 to 12.0.0 in /ui @dependabot (#4055)</li>

    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.54</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.54">Released</a> on September 08, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Install] Adapter: Kubernetes Manifests for NGINX Service Mesh @SirZeck (#4118)</li>
<li>[Install] K8s: Enable &lsquo;meshery-server&rsquo; Service Account with approve p… @leecalcote (#4114)</li>
<li>[Install] Kubernetes: Support v1.22 CRD v1 @leecalcote (#4115)</li>
<li>Fix performance profile retrieval issue @utkarsh-pro (#4109)</li>
<li>[Meshery] Lifecycle: move off deprecated alpha API for CRDs @leecalcote (#4104)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>migrate to meshkit errors in reset.go/ restart.go @nehaLohia27 (#3901)</li>
<li>Fetch manifest if not present during <code>system stop</code> for kubernetes @suhaniii (#4083)</li>
<li>Refactor YAML structure to a single file (for mesheryctl reference) @alphaX86 (#3985)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Pattern] add default value for pattern files, capitalize each word as title prop @bariqhibat (#4116)</li>
<li>Fix Pattern syncup with rjsf form @Abhishek-kumar09 (#4085)</li>
<li>[UI] User Preferences: Display Wait Indicator @K-Kumar-01 (#4106)</li>
<li>[UI] [Connection Wizard] Change operator inactive state color @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4012)</li>
<li>[Extensions] dependency add for meshery extensions @bariqhibat (#4112)</li>
<li>[UI] Supports accordion style menu in collapsed menu drawer @CipherGirl (#3890)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added DelusionalOptimist to CI Maintainers @adithyaakrishna (#4099)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Refactor YAML structure to a single file (for mesheryctl reference) @alphaX86 (#3985)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Abhishek-kumar09, @CipherGirl, @K-Kumar-01, @SirZeck, @adithyaakrishna, @alphaX86, @bariqhibat, @leecalcote, @nehaLohia27, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @suhaniii and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.55</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.55">Released</a> on September 09, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix meshsync data blockage @utkarsh-pro (#4133)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[mesheryctl]api rate limit issue and failing tests @Revolyssup (#4136)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Improve The Graph UI in Performance Profiles Page @veerreshr (#4041)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Docs] Avoid port conflict for NGINX-SM and TANZU-SM and update the tanzu-sm.md @SirZeck (#4124)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@Revolyssup, @SirZeck, @leecalcote, @utkarsh-pro and @veerreshr</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.57</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.57">Released</a> on September 13, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fix performance dashboard appearance @utkarsh-pro (#4169)</li>
<li>Improve performance tests graph @utkarsh-pro (#4170)</li>
<li>Extensions/refactor/styling @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4168)</li>
<li>fix nginx-sm manifests @DelusionalOptimist (#4163)</li>
<li>Fix invalid edges json schema @utkarsh-pro (#4160)</li>
<li>[Extensions] Add Play/Pause icon for meshmap @sudo-NithishKarthik (#4155)</li>
<li>Fix prometheus and grafana discovery @utkarsh-pro (#4153)</li>
<li>add reference to programatically submit form @killbotXD (#4152)</li>
<li>add remote dependency @killbotXD (#4150)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-ui">
	🖥 Meshery UI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[Extensions] New Verify icon: doublecheckicon @leecalcote (#4164)</li>
<li>[Application] Fix - distinguishing between url and file upload/import of Meshery applications @mgfeller (#4159)</li>
<li>[UI] Fix Runtime Error  @K-Kumar-01 (#4126)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>[CI] updated current workflows to put appropriate labels on PRs according to the files changed. @asubedy (#4151)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Fixed all broken links @iambami (#4021)</li>
<li>Added Traefik Mesh Lab to docs @iambami (#4141)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DelusionalOptimist, @K-Kumar-01, @asubedy, @iambami, @killbotXD, @leecalcote, @mgfeller, @sudo-NithishKarthik and @utkarsh-pro</p>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>

<h1>Meshery v0.5.58</h1>

<h4><a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/releases/tag/v0.5.58">Released</a> on September 17, 2021</h4>

<h2 id="whats-new">
	What&rsquo;s New
</h2>
<h2 id="-general">
	🔤 General
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix seed content registration bugs @DelusionalOptimist (#4205)</li>
<li>[Extension] RJSF - remove description and add tooltip to fields @bariqhibat (#4171)</li>
<li>Fix meshery-operator helm chart @panyuenlau (#4196)</li>
<li>Added Connectivity check for NATS and MeshSync + Minor Refactor @dhruv0000 (#4191)</li>
<li>fixed ui tests failing @warunicorn19 (#4194)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-features">
	🚀 Features
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added support for seeded content in local provider @Revolyssup (#4173)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-meshery-cli">
	⌨️ Meshery CLI
</h2>
<ul>
<li>tag for k8s - channel switch @suhaniii (#4132)</li>
<li>mesheryctl: Fix system start &ndash;reset to reset the meshconfig before s… @amitech (#4166)</li>
<li>Added more tests for <code>mesheryctl/internal/cli/root/config</code> @shikharvashistha (#4084)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-maintenance">
	🧰 Maintenance
</h2>
<ul>
<li>Added more tests for <code>mesheryctl/internal/cli/root/config</code> @shikharvashistha (#4084)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-documentation">
	📖 Documentation
</h2>
<ul>
<li>fix: broken link in adapters  @Shatakshi0805 (#4175)</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="-contributors">
	👨🏽‍💻 Contributors
</h2>
<p>Thank you to our contributors for making this release possible:
@DelusionalOptimist, @Revolyssup, @Shatakshi0805, @amitech, @bariqhibat, @dhruv0000, @leecalcote, @navendu-pottekkat, @panyuenlau, @piyushsingariya, @shikharvashistha, @sudo-NithishKarthik, @suhaniii, @utkarsh-pro and @warunicorn19</p>

<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"
    integrity="sha256-FgpCb/KJQlLNfOu91ta32o/NMZxltwRo8QtmkMRdAu8=" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>

<script>
    $(document).ready(function () {

        var toc = $('#TOC');

        
        
        
        
        var hasH1 = $('.td-content h1').length > 0;
        var topSelector = hasH1 ? 'h1' : 'h2';
        var subSelector = hasH1 ? 'h2, h3' : 'h3';

        sections = $('.td-content ' + topSelector);

        $.each(sections, function (idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if (!section.hasClass('noTOC')) {
                var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
                var parent = $("#" + div_id)
                var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text + '">' + div_text + '</a></li>';
                $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil(topSelector);
            $.each(contenders, function (idx, contender) {
                if (!$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && $(contender).is(subSelector)) {
                    var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                    var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                    var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text + '">' + contender_text + '</a></li>';
                    children.append(content);
                }
            })
            $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function (e) {
            
            let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
            
            $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {
                if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
                    
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
                if ($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
                    $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
                    $(this).addClass('selected');
                }
            });
        })
    });
</script>
